title: services.services.update
description: Payload of commands/service_update.sql. `hub_id`, `current_user_id` and `now` are injected by the runtime (§2.5). The statement overwrites every column it lists, so the schema demands the FULL snapshot — and the door is still PARTIAL for callers: `records.service.patch` (hub#632) makes the runtime read `services.services.get` with `service_id` and complete the omitted keys from the row BEFORE validating. Explicit `null` clears; omitted preserves. An existing service cannot have its fiscal category EMPTIED (services#33). Closed contract (services#9).

service_id.description: Id of the service to update, of this hub.

tax_category_key.description: Canonical fiscal category the service taxes by (ADR-0085). Required so the edit cannot leave behind a service nobody can charge; `minLength` closes the "" that `required` alone lets through.

category_id.description: Service category of THIS hub, or none. The statement checks the ownership and fails with `services.category_unavailable` if it belongs to another hub or is deleted (services#7).

pricing_type.description: Closed domain. `from` prices carry `min_price`/`max_price`; `free` sells at 0.

price.description: Minor units of the hub currency (ADR-0007/0123): 1500 = 15,00 € — never the typed-in major unit.

min_price.description: Lower bound of a `from`/`variable` price, in minor units. `min_price <= max_price` is enforced by the CHECK constraint (JSON Schema cannot compare two fields).

max_price.description: Upper bound of a `from`/`variable` price, in minor units.

slug.description: URL-safe key, unique per hub: lowercase, no spaces.
